fx.source: SET cotizacion, mid of buy and sell (set_aguila)

bait.band_rule: baja: an agency with 20 or more active listings, 1 in 50 or more of which vanished and came back within 60 days, or, where the portal's publish dates are its own, whose median listing has been up more than 450 days, unless RE/MAX co-listing offsets it; measured on RE/MAX agents, the one portal whose listings close, get cut and vanish in the capture
bait.definition: share of the portal's active listings with no price or on a default pin, published by an agency in band baja
bait.message_rule: WhatsApp bait rate over the random draw, printed once 50 sampled questions are answered (pipeline/validate-report.mjs)
bait.strict_definition: share with no price and on a default pin and from an agency in band baja

transfer_activity.source: Registro Unificado Nacional (RUN), datos_dgrp.csv releases at www.run.gov.py/estadisticas
transfer_activity.basis: entries of type Transferencias per month, counts not prices; Asunción sums its six registry sections
transfer_activity.line: Registry transfers, Oct 2025, the latest month the registry (RUN) has published (release of Nov 2025), counts of registered transfers, not prices: Paraguay 4,512, +2.2% on Oct 2024 (4,413), +9.9% on the 12-month average (4,104); Asunción 341, +10.7% on Oct 2024 (308), +10.6% on the 12-month average (308); Central 1,471, +3.5% on Oct 2024 (1,421), +13.0% on the 12-month average (1,301). The 12-month average runs Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.
